name: Pythonator
title: Pythonator – Programmable Combinator
author: Ypsilonx
description: A combinator you program in Python. Replace tangled combinator setups with readable code – loop() runs every tick with deterministic 1-tick timing, like vanilla combinators. Snippet buttons and a signal picker help you start, ALT mode shows what every building reads and sends. [Early development – feedback welcome]
